title: Majority takes values in the signs
statement: For every $m\in\mathbb N$ and every $x\in\{0,1\}^{2m+1}$, the majority function, which is $1$ when more than $m$ coordinates are false and $-1$ otherwise, takes a value in $\{-1,1\}$.
replaced:
Let $m\in\mathbb N$, put $n=2m+1$, and define $M_m:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ by
$M_m(x)=1$ when more than $m$ coordinates equal $1$, and $M_m(x)=-1$ otherwise.
Then $M_m(x)\in\{1,-1\}$ for every $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$.
